title: Majrīṭ and Ṭulayṭula: a rising town and a growing industry. On the flat plains of the Tagus and the Manzanares the crown is building another centre of Andalusī power in the heart of the peninsula: weaponsmiths at Ṭulayṭula, mines, wheat farms and lumber mills in the country between the two cities and up to the Guadarrama

underConstruction: a mine and a lumber mill toward the Guadarrama, by Colmenar (the game's Qelmnar) and Buitrago del Lozoya
further works between Toledo and Madrid (Trent's map screen shows seven building sites in progress)
data.note: Trent's map screen of 13 March 1396 uses the game's Arabic-style names Ṭlayṭla and Qelmnar; Madrid itself is the 'new rising town'

source: Trent's account and map screen, 13 March 1396
